findings.title: External embed content is stored and rendered as raw HTML
findings.body: TopicEmbed.import creates posts with skip_validations and cook_method set to Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]. Content imported from RSS/Atom feeds or remote pages is not sanitized before storage, and Post#cook returns the raw HTML for this cook method. This allows untrusted external HTML, including scripts and dangerous markup, to be stored and later rendered in Discourse pages.

This can happen when embedding is partially configured: embeddable_host is set, but no import username has been chosen.

findings.body: TopicRetriever#invalid_host? compares SiteSetting.embeddable_host with the URI host. If embeddable_host is blank and the parsed URI also has a nil host, the method returns false instead of treating the URL as invalid. The retriever should explicitly reject retrieval when no embeddable host is configured.

If the process crashes or the expire call fails between these two operations, the Redis key remains forever without a TTL, permanently throttling retrieval for that embed URL. An atomic SET with NX and expiry should be used.
